subject.title: feat: Cron job tags/categories for organization and filtering

question: Should cron organization use freeform user tags, a typed purpose/display metadata contract, or a narrower reminder/plugin-owned classification model?
rationale: This choice becomes a persisted cron and Gateway protocol contract that affects CLI, UI, plugin scheduling, reminders, and possible bulk operations, so automation should not choose the permanent shape alone.

options.title: Typed classification/display contract
options.body: Add a first-party optional cron classification shape that can support user tags plus typed purpose/display metadata for reminders and plugin-created jobs.

options.title: Freeform tags only
options.body: Implement the reported tags array and tag filters directly, accepting that future typed reminder/display metadata may need a second contract.

options.title: Reminders-first split
options.body: Solve the Reminders tab with a narrow purpose/display field first and revisit broad user tags later.

recommendation.title: Typed classification/display contract
recommendation.body: Add a first-party optional cron classification shape that can support user tags plus typed purpose/display metadata for reminders and plugin-created jobs.

likelyOwner.reason: He made the closest prior maintainer call on cron metadata/API direction by closing the related opaque metadata PR for owner-reviewed design.
